theme_and_archetype.vibe: Unapologetic, Blazing Fast, Reliable, Technical yet accessible, High-end Editorial

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Asymmetry, Optical Alignment over Geometrical
spacing_and_layout.hero: Asymmetrical, left-aligned, overlapping textual elements, dramatic viewport-scaled headings.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for marketing/services. Control Room Grid for Admin Dashboard.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#020617]/70 border-b border-white/10 shadow-sm
surfaces.marketing_cards: Tactile Brutalism: 1px solid border (#334155), flat dark background (#0F172A), sharp or max 8px radius.
surfaces.pricing_cards: Glassmorphism for premium tiers: backdrop-blur-lg bg-[#0F2650]/40 border border-[#F26B21]/50. Solid for standard tiers.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat, cardless or 1px subtle border, very dense spacing. No heavy shadows.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F26B21] text-white font-semibold rounded-md hover:bg-[#F78B4D] transition-colors duration-200 px-6 py-3
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#334155] text-white font-medium rounded-md hover:bg-[#1E293B] hover:border-slate-500 transition-all duration-200 px-6 py-3

components.forms: Use Shadcn customized for dark mode. Darker input backgrounds (#0F172A), border (#334155), lighter placeholders.
components.pricing_toggle: Pill-shaped toggle, distinct active state using #F26B21.
components.badges: font-mono text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-[#F26B21]/10 text-[#F26B21] border border-[#F26B21]/20 rounded-full

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with border color shifting to #F26B21/50.
motion_and_interactions.micro_animations: Use Framer Motion for staggered list entrances. Smooth scroll using Lenis (if applicable).

hero_backgrounds.description: Abstract orange/blue fiber optic light streaks, perfect for high-speed internet hero background.
Dark geometric orange architecture, good for structural/business section.

services_and_tech.description: Smart home living room at night with TV, for OTT bundle visualization.

icons.strategy: Minimalist, tech-focused, paired with JetBrains Mono for stats.

testing_attributes.strategy: All interactive elements MUST use data-testid kebab-case role-based attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-subscribe-button', data-testid='admin-login-submit').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (headings), 'IBM Plex Sans' (body), and 'JetBrains Mono' (prices/speeds) via Google Fonts or next/font (if Next.js) or standard CSS import.
Implement the dark theme strictly. Do NOT use gradients that muddy the background. Keep the deep navy (#020617) as a solid base.
For the Plans Page, build a robust toggle system (Monthly, 6-Month, 12-Month, Welcome, OTT). Use JetBrains Mono for the speeds and prices to give a technical, data-driven feel.
Use the brand orange (#F26B21) sparingly but sharply for CTAs, speed metrics, and active states. It should pop against the dark background.
Build the Admin Panel (/admin route) using Shadcn components (tables, dialogs, forms) without heavy cards (use cardless/minimal borders) for a dense 'control room' vibe.
Implement an OTP-style password reset UI on the admin login screen.
Always apply 'data-testid' to actionable items (forms, toggles, buttons) for testing.
Do not use generic font Inter. Ensure all typography choices are applied in the tailwind config and root CSS.
